context: An Egyptian finance explainer on how betting houses make money: the 'house' (the betting company) takes a commission on every bet, so win or lose the house always wins; all it needs is a full shop, people walking in and betting.

shots.name: casino-exterior
shots.line: البيت هاوس دي إشارة لشركة المراهنات نفسها (the house = the betting company itself)
shots.subject: a grand casino building facade at night seen from street level at a slight three-quarter angle: tall entrance with a marquee canopy (blank, no letters), rows of bulb lights, revolving glass doors, two short steps
shots.free_style: A real-looking photograph, cinematic night light.

shots.name: slot-machines
shots.line: الشركة دي اللي بتستقبل حجم الرهان (the company receives the betting handle)
shots.subject: a row of three casino slot machines side by side, three-quarter view, pull levers, blank reels with simple fruit and bell symbols (no digits or words), coin trays
shots.free_style: A real-looking photograph inside a casino, warm light.

shots.name: chips-on-felt
shots.line: حجم الرهان ده كل الفلوس اللي الناس حطتها (the handle = all the money people put in)
shots.subject: a large heap of casino chips pushed together on a curved strip of plain betting felt, a croupier's wooden rake resting against the heap
shots.free_style: A real-looking close-up photograph, shallow depth of field.

shots.name: betting-app-phone
shots.line: عملية رهان يعني ترانزاكشن عادي خالص (a bet is just an ordinary transaction)
shots.subject: a hand holding a smartphone showing a sports betting app screen made only of simple shapes: two team crest circles, three odds buttons as blank rounded rectangles and a confirm bar (no digits or letters)
shots.accent: the confirm bar on the screen
shots.free_style: A real-looking photograph, phone screen glow.

shots.name: casino-floor-crowd
shots.line: هدف البيت الأساسي هو إن المحل يكون مليان (the house's goal: a full shop)
shots.subject: a busy casino floor packed with anonymous people around roulette and card tables, seen from a slightly raised angle, chandeliers above
shots.free_style: A real-looking photograph, people seen from behind or blurred, no identifiable faces.
